description: This file defines the DigitalSignatureOptions class, which specifies configuration options for digital signatures within the PDFsharp library, including appearance, contact info, location, reason, application name, signature rectangle, and page index.

classes.name: DigitalSignatureOptions
classes.description: A class that encapsulates options for digital signature appearance and metadata in PDF documents.
